description:
**Research Executive – Industrial Training \& Content Development**

**Company:** Samadhan Group  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Education:** B.Tech / B.E. (Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or related fields preferred)

About the Role

Samadhan Group is looking for a **Research Executive** to support research, technical content development, industrial training programs, and curriculum/module development.

The ideal candidate should have an engineering/technical background with strong **research, documentation, content development, presentation, or industrial process knowledge**.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct research on industries, manufacturing processes, technologies, job roles, and emerging skill requirements.
* Develop **training modules, learning materials, technical presentations, manuals, handbooks, and research reports**.
* Convert technical/industrial information into simple and structured learning content.
* Research and analyze industrial job roles, processes, technologies, and market trends.
* Support development of **curriculum, learning outcomes, competencies, and training content**.
* Prepare PPTs, technical documents, briefs, reports, and project documentation.
* Develop content for **e\-learning videos, quizzes, animations, podcasts, and digital learning material**.
* Assist in preparing proposals, technical documents, tenders, and project\-related reports.
* Coordinate with industry experts, trainers, academic institutions, and other stakeholders.
* Support projects related to **skill development, vocational training, industrial training, and workforce development**.

Requirements

* B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* **1–5 years of experience** in any of the following areas:
* Research / Research Analysis
* Technical Writing / Technical Content
* Curriculum or Module Development
* Training \& Learning Content
* Industrial / Manufacturing Processes
* Engineering Research
* Technical Documentation
* Instructional Design / Content Development
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and present them in a simple, structured manner.
* Good knowledge of **MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint**.
* Ability to conduct secondary research and prepare professional reports and presentations.

Good to Have

* Exposure to **NSQF, NCVET, Sector Skill Councils (SSC)** or government skill\-development projects.
* Experience in manufacturing, production, industrial training, R\&D or engineering projects.
* Experience creating training manuals, participant handbooks, facilitator guides or e\-learning content.
* Knowledge of Canva or other content\-development tools.

**Eligible Candidates**

Candidates from **Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Technical Research, Technical Writing, Training Content, Curriculum Development, Subject Matter Experts and Engineering Research** backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

**M.Tech / PhD is not mandatory.**

**Keywords:** Research Executive, Research Associate, Research Analyst, Technical Writer, Technical Content Developer, Curriculum Developer, Training Content Developer, Mechanical Engineer, Production Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Researcher, Instructional Designer.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
